scientific_integrity: The main identities are proved analytically from invariance and the printed model equations. Numerical parameter values are used only as exact illustrations. Closest same-system limit-cycle literature was compared at statement level; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic continuous-time chemostat; compact invariant measures supported in the strict positive octant; Holling-II predator response; strict equality classification uses strict monotonicity of the nutrient response. No existence, uniqueness, stability, period, stochastic, delay, or boundary claim is made.
title: Shifted harmonic-mean rigidity for recurrent prey density in a chemostat
